lee_design: Quick design review — putting up a proposed change to the p95 metric card. lee_design: Problem: folks are interpreting 'window' as the global time picker, not the metric aggregation. lee_design: Proposal: rename 'window' → 'aggregation window' and add a subtle (i) hover explainer: \"How we aggregate: bucket size used to compute percentiles across traces.\" Added comp in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123 (see 'p95 card / aggregation'). ashley_eng: +1 on clarifying label. Q: will this break alerting thresholds? we use 'window' in alert queries today. lee_design: Good point — implementation note: keep backend param named `rollup_window` but change only the UI label. We'll add a migration note in docs. priya_pm: Sounds fine. UX suggestion: for first-time users show a one-time tooltip. Suggested copy: \"Aggregation window: bucket size used to compute percentiles.\" Shorter alt: \"Bucket size used to compute percentiles.\" maria_g: Accessibility nits: contrast for the (i) icon is low at 12px; needs 4.5:1. Also missing keyboard focus outline when the icon is tabbed. Tooltip must be reachable by keyboard (aria-describedby + focusable element). samir: Also recommend explicit aria-label on the chart container: `aria-label=\"Latency (p95) over time — aggregation window 30s\"`. For presets, ensure tab order is: timepicker → presets → sampling toggle (predictable). ashley_eng: Implementation concern: sampling toggle state currently not persisted per-dashboard; should that be global? If we persist per-panel, we need storage schema. Proposal: persist per-panel in localStorage with key `redwood.latency.panel.{panelId}.sampling` unless enterprise want server-side. lee_design: I prefer per-panel so different dashboards can have different sampling. UI: show a small badge when sampling is active: e.g., `sampling: 10%` with a tooltip explaining what that means for p95 accuracy. priya_pm: Analytics ask: please fire events when users change aggregation window and sampling rate. Event names: `latency.window.change`, `latency.sampling.change` with props {panel_id, old, new, user_segment}. maria_g: Microcopy tweak: tooltip currently says \"95th percentile latency\" — change to \"Latency at the 95th percentile\" (reads clearer in screen reader output). lee_design: Draft tooltip aria pattern below — keeps tooltip accessible and keyboard reachable: ``` Aggregation window
Bucket size used to compute percentiles across traces.
``` ashley_eng: OK, I'll add `aria-describedby` and make sure the icon is focusable. Will add an automated test for tooltip presence and keyboard focus. Also will namespace localStorage keys. samir: One more thought: for very small aggregation windows (<10s) we should show a warning: \"Low window may produce noisy percentiles\" with an inline `learn more` link. Could be a future follow-up. lee_design: Noted. Action items: Lee — update Figma and the tooltip copy; Ashley — add aria attributes, localStorage schema and PR; Priya — add analytics events and doc the event contract; Samir — draft aria-label examples and keyboard flow; Maria — verify contrast and focus styles. uxbot: Created task INFR-3421 and linked figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123?node-id=42 lee_design: Thanks all — let's sync in design review tomorrow at 11am. :thumbsup:
